commit.message: Add a new builtin module that allows the creation of a custom MediaStream that can accept frames from discord_voice directly
fix: specify `typeRoots` to avoid crawling parent directories

issues.title: Update electron
issues.body:
Please just do it....If there are any breaking changes you still need to change discord's source code ofc. Just focus on that for a moment and everyone will love you.

EDIT: As of the 11th of February 2023, Discord Canary switched to Electron 22. This is a great step. Also for those who complained about this PR...it should be more of a heads up to the Discord Team and not an actual thing that should be merged.

issues.title: skid proof 2: webm edition
issues.body:
I said in the previous patch that I'd fix the vpx allocator later, well, later is now ;)

Stay tuned for the next installment when the kids figure out av1.

issues.title: add demuxers/decoders we want to ffmpeg config
issues.body:
Once I've verified this and delivered the things to [REDACTED], I'm going to create a CI process for... this... because I think we're going to want to split the script change from the checked in script output and regenerate it for future rolls.

see also, https://docs.google.com/document/d/14bqZ9NISsyEO3948wehhJ7wc9deTIz-yHUhF1MQp7Po/edit#

issues.title: backport: macos 12.0 sdk support
issues.body: cc @adill macos build boxes were updated. patch is backported from upstream chrome w/mild merge conflict fixes. they were doing something slightly hinky with accessibility functions that previously were not public API
